title: Community Health Worker
author: Dayone Koo
_comment: Dialectical surface for the Foothill Community Health Worker report. Edit this file; the /report/saved/ endpoint re-renders on refresh. Fields mirror ReportSpec overrides (lede, *_note, live_postings). Foothill feeds this from TWO TOPs: 126100 Community Health Care Worker (19 awards, growing 10->11->19) and 120100 Health Occupations General (60). CCSF dominates the region at 302 awards on 126100. NOTE 21-1094 is an unusually leaky SOC on CareerOneStop: 181 listings returned, but most are unrelated (Merchandiser, Dockworker, BGA Rework Operator) — the three selected are the exact-title matches from real Bay health organizations; staffing-agency listings (Amergis) were discarded per the recognizability axis.
_programs_note: EDITORIAL OVERRIDE of the default partner selection. select_partner_programs picks each college's LARGEST feeding program, which mixed TOP 126100 (Community Health Care Worker — the program actually named for this occupation) with TOP 120100 (Health Occupations, General — a generic pre-health program that also crosswalks to 21-1094). That produced an incoherent set where Foothill was represented by 120100 (251 5-yr awards) rather than its own CHW program (40). Restricting to 126100 makes every row the same kind of program. Foothill's supply reads 40 rather than 251 — the smaller number is the honest one, since 120100 completers mostly continue into nursing and allied health, not community health work.

21-1094.title: SLH Care Management Community Health Worker

21-1094.description: Promotes health within a community by helping residents adopt healthy behaviors and advocating for their needs with healthcare providers and social service agencies.
